title: The agent-run back office
summary: The monthly money loop with the highest agent ceiling of any recurring playbook here: payroll run, vendors paid, invoices out, books closed, runway read, board updated — roughly nine steps in ten agent-routed, most reachable today over judged MCP servers and CLIs.

parts.title: Run payroll
parts.guidance: Collect the approved payroll period, employee changes, hours and adjustments before opening the payroll workflow. Reconcile its preview to the expected pay run and obtain the payroll approver's release. Bring the payroll register, payment results and unresolved exceptions into the monthly books, distinguishing released, paid and failed items.

parts.title: Pay vendor invoices
parts.guidance: Build this month's payable queue from invoices, purchase approvals and receiving evidence. Use the vendor-payment workflow to investigate duplicates and changed bank details, then obtain approval for the specific payment batch. Carry confirmed payments, unpaid items and disputes into the close so the accountant can reconcile cash and liabilities without guessing from invoice status.

parts.title: Send an invoice
parts.guidance: Assemble billable work, signed commercial terms and the customer's billing details. Use the invoicing workflow to prepare and review the charges, then send only under the billing owner's authority. Pass invoice identifiers, delivery evidence and outstanding balances into bookkeeping; track payment separately from invoice delivery.

parts.title: Bookkeeping close
parts.guidance: Close the same reporting period used for payroll, payables and invoicing. Supply their supporting registers and reconcile bank activity, unpaid balances and accounting adjustments in the bookkeeping workflow. Return a reviewed close package with open exceptions clearly separated, so the runway calculation and board report use the same version of the numbers.

parts.title: Track runway
parts.guidance: Use reconciled cash and the latest spending assumptions to refresh runway. Separate actual cash movements from forecasts, restricted balances and exceptional spending. Carry the calculation date, period, scenario assumptions and unresolved reconciliation issues into the board report so readers can see what changed and which decisions would alter the outlook.

parts.title: Send the board financial report
parts.guidance: Prepare the board's financial update from the approved close and runway analysis. Explain material movements, cash risks and decisions requested, using consistent periods and units. Have the finance owner review the package and authorize its recipients before distribution; retain the version sent and any questions that need follow-up in the next cycle.
